note: Nine fictional race teams, two cars and two drivers each (a race runs one car per team). Colours are sRGB hex. 'cars' uses the keys of car-lab profiles / assets/cars . 'finish' is a car-lab paint finish. Team names are invented for Ultrack; sponsor logos are real-world marks for the local fan prototype; see TEAMS.md. 'sponsor' is the team's title sponsor, one of the trackside brands (tracks/marina/venue.py SPONSORS); one per team (Sony, Hayate's, is an extra team-sponsor brand with trackside boards). 'light' (optional) is the team's lighting colour for banner LEDs, garage and pit lighting; 'colors.ink' (optional) is the text colour on the team's primary where the accent is too pale to read on it (Toro's yellow). 'font' (optional 'bold': faux-bold stroke, in em, for light faces) is the team's display face (SIL OFL, in track-viewer/public/assets/fonts) for its name on cars, banners and garages. 'pitBoxes' are the team's pit boxes by car order (the marina track has only 12 boxes for 18 cars, so Corvid, Hayate, Mojave and Liberty have one each and Norrsken none; a car without a box is not parked in the pit lane) (track.json pitLane.boxes ids, 1 = first along the lane).

teams.name: Saetta

driver.name: Sofia Calderini
driver.bio: Swiss-Italian former karting world champion; the coolest head on the grid.
driver.background: From Lugano, in Italian-speaking Switzerland; karting world champion at seventeen, then studied architecture before Saetta called.
driver.personality: Plays chess with her engineers between sessions; her heart rate on the grid is famously low; out-qualified Varrone when he was her teammate and has never mentioned it.

driver.name: Thiago Barreto
driver.bio: Three-time Stock Car Brasil champion with a smile for every camera; Saetta's loudest answer to losing Varrone.
driver.background: From Curitiba, Brazil; swept the kart track his uncle ran before winning three Stock Car Brasil titles; Vittoria Saldani signed him on a restaurant napkin the week Varrone left.
driver.personality: Dances on the grid and sings opera arias, badly, over the team radio on the formation lap (Saldani adores it); signs every autograph with a lightning bolt; determined to prove Saetta never needed Varrone.

teams.livery: deep rosso body; a single gold lightning bolt fractures along each flank from the front wheel to the rear haunch; tricolore tab on the mirror caps; gold numbers in a white roundel

teams.name: Toro

driver.name: Matteo Varrone
driver.bio: Saetta's golden boy until the AV-12 went home to Toro and he went with it; brakes later than anyone and apologises to no one.
driver.background: Born in Modena, son of a Saetta machinist; in the Saetta academy from fourteen. Drove the AV-12 Toro lent Saetta for a season under the Via Emilia truce; when the loan ended and the car went back to Sant'Agata, he went with it.
driver.personality: Hot-blooded on the radio, adored by Toro's faithful and whistled by Saetta's tifosi; kisses the lightning bolt on his helmet before every start, and nobody at Toro dares ask him to peel it off.

driver.name: Paloma Ortega
driver.bio: A retired matador's daughter who lets the others charge, then steps aside at the last metre of the braking zone.
driver.background: From Seville; her father fought bulls for twenty years, and she grew up in the bullring's stable yard before running away to karts at twelve; European GT champion when Toro signed the one driver who would not charge.
driver.personality: Ice-cold and patient; hates the headline nickname 'La Torera' and has stopped correcting it. At a team called the bull, teammate Varrone is the bull and she is the matador, and both know it.

teams.livery: giallo yellow body; two black horn blades sweep up and back from the front wheel along each flank, edged in bone white; a broad matte-black stripe over the roof between two white pinstripes; numbers in a black roundel with a bone ring and yellow digits

teams.name: Corvid
teams.meaning: the raven and crow family: clever, black-eyed, everywhere

driver.name: Theo Ashcombe
driver.bio: Third-generation racer with impeccable manners and none on track.
driver.background: Grandfather raced at Silverstone, father ran Corvid's test team; grew up in the paddock.
driver.personality: Writes a handwritten apology note after every collision, then does it again; a running feud with Varrone since they touched at the Corniche hairpin.

driver.name: Kai Whitlow
driver.bio: The oldest driver on the grid, endurance-bred; never hurries, never fades.
driver.background: Grew up on a sheep station in Canterbury, New Zealand; three endurance class wins before Corvid signed him.
driver.personality: The Metronome: lap times within a tenth for hours; surfs between races; quietly mentors the rookies, even on other teams.

teams.livery: British racing green; cream nose band and roundels; brass pinstripe that sweeps up the door like a raven's feather; small heraldic raven crest on the bonnet

teams.name: Mojave
teams.meaning: the California desert the team was built in
teams.line: Built in a barn. Feared in the paddock.

driver.name: Freya Lindqvist
driver.bio: Rally-bred car control; at her best when the grip goes.
driver.background: From Värmland, Sweden; forest rallies and ice racing on frozen lakes until Cal Beaumont watched her slide a car across one and offered her a seat at Mojave.
driver.personality: Deadpan; says grip is overrated and means it; the brawler Maddox's great rival (she slides the car, he shoves it); the one person at Mojave who has never been impressed by the barn.

driver.name: Rosa Quintero
driver.bio: Rookie of the year; the fastest qualifier Mojave has ever had.
driver.background: From Monterrey; sim-racing world champion who won her seat in Mojave's esports shootout.
driver.personality: Frighteningly fast over one lap, still learning racecraft in traffic; the youngest driver on the grid and openly out to beat Valois.

teams.livery: desert orange; navy sunburst stripes fanning back from the front wheel arches; a white star in the number box; scuffed rivet graphics along the sills

teams.name: Aurum
teams.line: Luxury, at three hundred an hour.

driver.name: Remy Valois
driver.bio: The reigning champion; smooth, smiling, and very hard to pass.
driver.background: Born in Monte Carlo, son of a yacht broker; two titles with Aurum.
driver.personality: Never raises his voice on the radio; listens to old jazz on the grid; his charm is half the psychology.

driver.name: Armand Beaulieu
driver.bio: Endurance-bred Frenchman in a tailored suit; never hurries, never scuffs a tyre.
driver.background: From Lyon, the son of a silk merchant; a decade of endurance prototypes and three Le Mans class podiums before Aurum gave Valois a teammate he could not charm.
driver.personality: Dresses for the grid as if for a gala; calls Valois 'le Prince' to his face; collects vintage watches; never swears, but his sigh on the radio is worse.

teams.livery: midnight blue; champagne-gold art-deco fan pinstripes on the bonnet and rear deck; an 'A' monogram in a gold lozenge; numbers in a thin gold serif

teams.name: Liberty
teams.meaning: English: freedom; the cracked bell of Philadelphia

driver.name: Cole Maddox
driver.bio: Dirt-track brawler; drives every lap like the last one.
driver.background: From Bakersfield, California; sprint cars and dirt ovals from age nine, until Liberty's Harlan Whitfield flew in to watch him win a county-fair dirt race and signed him on the spot.
driver.personality: The most penalised driver in the paddock; cowboy boots, no filter, big heart; the stewards know number 66 by heart; he and teammate Hollis cannot agree on who is the real American.

driver.name: Wade Hollis
driver.bio: Former air-force test pilot; flies every lap like a flight plan.
driver.background: From Abilene, Texas; fourteen years as a test pilot before a charity race showed he was faster on the ground.
driver.personality: Speaks in checklists and calls corners 'waypoints'; unflappable on the radio; flies himself to every race in a vintage trainer; he and teammate Maddox cannot agree on who is the real American.

teams.livery: royal-blue body; a red-and-white stripe pair streams back from the front wheel along each flank like a flag in wind; a field of white stars on the front fender; red and white racing stripes over the roof; royal-blue light strips (the team's lighting colour) edge the number roundel, banners and garage; numbers in a white roundel with a red ring

teams.name: Sarab

driver.name: Zayn Kareem
driver.bio: The home hero; the crowd stands up every time he pits.
driver.background: Grew up on the Corniche; powerboat racer on the marina as a teenager before Sarab put him in a car.
driver.personality: Carries a whole city's expectations; generous with fans; wants Valois's crown, and knows his teammate is often quicker.

driver.name: Layla Qasimi
driver.bio: Omani, self-taught on desert roads; the grid's best overtaker.
driver.background: Learned to drive on graded desert roads near Oman's Wahiba Sands in her uncle's pickup; Sarab signed her after her first season in club racing.
driver.personality: Fearless and cheerful; holds the record for passes in a single race; friendly rivalry with teammate Kareem that splits the crowd.

teams.livery: pearl white; teal dune contour lines that flow from nose to tail like a topographic map; a sand-gold falcon on the roof; numbers in teal with a gold drop shadow

teams.name: Hayate
teams.meaning: Japanese: 疾風, a sudden gale
teams.home: Oyama, Shizuoka (in the shadow of Mt Fuji)
teams.line: You hear us after we pass.

driver.name: Kaito Mizuno
driver.bio: Touge drift champion from the Izu mountain passes; steers with the throttle.
driver.background: Born in Numazu, Shizuoka, a fishmonger's son who learned to slide a car on the Izu Skyline at night before going legal in D1 and Super GT; Hamamoto signed him after watching him drift a full wet lap of Fuji.
driver.personality: Calm in the car, chatty out of it; bows to every marshal; treats the apex as a suggestion; he and Lindqvist have argued for two seasons about who is the better sideways, and he and teammate Kuroda about whether sideways is fast.

driver.name: Rina Kuroda
driver.bio: Former Super GT champion from Toyota City; the grid's most precise qualifier.
driver.background: From Toyota City, Aichi, a supplier engineer's daughter with her first kart at six; took the Super GT GT300 title at 24 and an engineering degree on the side; Hamamoto hired her to build the car around her.
driver.personality: Speaks on the radio only in lap numbers and tenths; keeps a handwritten logbook of every lap she has driven; respects Valois and would very much like to beat him; says Mizuno's sliding is murder on the tyres, then watches every replay.

teams.livery: murasaki-violet body; a seigaiha wave band in white and vermilion rolls back over each rear quarter; kanji number roundels (二十三, 三十七) behind the door; the 疾風 wordmark on the bonnet and rear deck; a white SONY panel on the door and a katakana ソニー plate on the rear wing; vermilion stripes over the roof; vermilion LED strips (the team's lighting colour) edge the number roundel, banners and garage; numbers in a white roundel with a vermilion ring

teams.name: Norrsken

driver.name: Elin Hagberg
driver.bio: Single-seater champion with an aerospace degree; sets up her own car and is rarely wrong.
driver.background: From Gothenburg, a ship designer's daughter; European single-seater champion at twenty-one, then three years as a works development driver before Henrik Wallgren made her the first driver Norrsken ever signed.
driver.personality: Quiet, exact and impossible to rattle; reads telemetry in the car on the cool-down lap; thinks Calderini is the only driver on the grid who prepares as hard as she does, and Valois the only one worth beating.

driver.name: Jari Koskinen
driver.bio: Finnish rallycross champion who drives best in the dark and the wet; says three words a weekend.
driver.background: From Jyväskylä, Finland; a farm mechanic's son on the gravel stages from fifteen, two rallycross titles, then endurance night stints for anyone who would pay; Norrsken signed him for the races that end after sunset.
driver.personality: Says almost nothing on the radio and less to the press; a sauna after every race, wherever it is; the old Finland-Sweden rivalry with Lindqvist is the one thing that makes him talk.

teams.livery: graphite body; a curtain of aurora-green light ribbons rises from the sill along each rear flank and fades out toward the roofline; twin green pinstripes over the roof; aurora-green LED strips (the team's lighting colour) edge the number roundel, banners and garage; numbers in ice white in a graphite roundel with a green ring
